basics.name: Samiul Alam
basics.label: Software Engineer at Google | Ph.D. in Computer Science & Engineering
basics.summary: Software Engineer at Google. Ph.D. in Computer Science & Engineering from The Ohio State University. Spatial computing, multimodal foundation models, agentic recommendation systems, on-device AI, and federated learning. “Perpetually Convalescent: Learning & Evolving.”

work.name: Google
work.summary: Working on user activity modeling and development of agentic recommendation systems.

work.name: Meta
work.summary: Worked with the Sensors and Systems Research team at Reality Labs on energy-efficient egocentric perception for prototype wearable glasses.
highlights: Developed and deployed a reinforcement learning-based dynamic camera capture model on prototype wearable glasses
Optimized on-sensor capture to minimize energy consumption and maximize AI assistant performance

work.name: Google
work.summary: Worked on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and synthetic-to-real user browsing data alignment for personalized recommendation systems.
highlights: Multimodal LLMs for personalized recommendation systems

work.name: The Ohio State University
work.summary: Conducted doctoral research in the AIoT-MLSys Lab advised by Prof. Mi Zhang on spatial computing, supermemory for AR glasses, model compression, and multimodal foundation models.
highlights: Built MemoLens (MobiSys '26), SuperMemory-VQA, and Reading Recognition in the Wild (NeurIPS '25) for AR glasses
Developed SVD-LLM V2 (NAACL '25) for large language model compression

work.name: Michigan State University
work.summary: Built heterogeneity-aware federated learning systems; published across top venues.
highlights: Geo-distributed and heterogeneous federated learning (FedRolex, FedAIoT, FedSEA, FedAudio)
Publications at NeurIPS, SenSys, ICASSP, INTERSPEECH, and DMLR

work.name: University of Houston
work.summary: Worked on deconvolution, state-space modeling, and Bayesian filters.
highlights: State-space models for physiological and cognitive signal analysis
Bayesian filtering and sparse multichannel decomposition

work.name: Samsung R&D Institute Bangladesh
work.summary: Extended BLE interfacing for wearable apps on iOS and Android; developed cloud service SDK; earned Samsung Software Certification (Top 10%).
highlights: BLE interfacing for Samsung Galaxy Wearable apps
Controller app for 5G smart router and cloud service SDK

work.name: Bengali.AI
work.summary: Non-profit for open-source Bengali datasets and benchmarks for speech, vision, and text.
highlights: Community dataset curation (NumtaDB, Bengali Handwritten Graphemes, Common Voice Bengali, OOD-Speech)
Organized international machine learning competitions on Kaggle

projects.name: MemoLens
projects.summary: Empowering augmented reality glasses with super memory via gaze-guided spatio-temporal token compression and hierarchical multimodal retrieval (ACM MobiSys '26).

projects.name: SuperMemory-VQA
projects.summary: Long-horizon egocentric visual question-answering benchmark built from 52.9 hours of multi-sensor AI glasses recordings with 4,853 human-verified QA pairs.

projects.name: Reading Recognition in the Wild
projects.summary: First large-scale multimodal dataset (100 hours) and transformer model using egocentric RGB, eye gaze, and head pose for selective memory creation on smart glasses (NeurIPS '25).

projects.name: SVD-LLM V2 Model Compression
projects.summary: Optimizing singular value truncation via dynamic compression ratio allocation and loss-optimized truncation for efficient LLM deployment (NAACL '25).

projects.name: FedRolex & FedAIoT
projects.summary: Frameworks and benchmarks for model-heterogeneous and authentic AIoT federated learning under varied bandwidth and compute constraints (NeurIPS '22, DMLR '24).

projects.name: 5G Smart Router Interfacing
projects.summary: Interface and AR visualization for mesh network strength, channel estimation, and optimal router placement.
